text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, and E after gains felt rewarding, but those trades may have limited further upside; I should set sell rules based on outlook and portfolio needs, not the comfort of a realized gain.","Buying more Stock B after it rose from my earlier purchase risks chasing recent performance; I should size positions deliberately and avoid letting confidence or regret drive add-on trades.","My account value rose overall despite a few down months and no trades in several periods. I should assess progress over time and keep a diversified plan instead of reacting to each month's fluctuation."]}
